text:
Diego (Recruiter): New hire Amina O starting Mon 9am PT. US employment, currently in London for 3 weeks. Wants to start remotely. She can't do US I-9 in-person until she returns.
Sofia (People Ops): Quick Q: can we accept a third-party authorized representative in the UK for I-9? Remote hires abroad need a company-appointed agent or notary.
Global HR Bot: Reminder: I-9 must be completed within 3 business days of start date. Exception flow: "authorized representative" allowed but company must accept liability for agent verification.
Sofia (People Ops): Legal, any red flags with appointing a local notary? We used NotaryNet in EU before but that vendor flagged E-Verify restrictions for certain hires.
Legal (Contracting): We can authorize a UK notary as rep, but payroll can't complete E-Verify checks on overseas verifications. If hire is eligible for E-Verify, we need to complete E-Verify within 3 days — that requires verification in the US or via our approved vendor.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate is US citizen — E-Verify required. She said she can return in 10 days. She wants to start earlier.
Sofia (People Ops): Options: 1) Delay official start until she returns and do I-9 in-person (clean) 2) Approve remote start as contingent on I-9 completion; limit access (no payroll until I-9 done, contractor status) 3) Try to use approved I-9 vendor with international agent but E-Verify likely fails.
Payroll (Ops): Important: payroll needs W-4 + SSN before first run. If I-9 incomplete, we can hold direct deposit and issue a one-time check, but taxes default if W-4 missing.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate asked about equipment and if she can start using personal laptop. Concerned about security.
Sofia (People Ops): We can do a short-term stipend for equipment courier when she arrives, or ship equipment to her UK address but lock admin access until I-9/E-Verify cleared. Alternatively, allow start on personal device with VPN + MDM enforced, but limit production access.
Legal (Contracting): If we permit remote start before E-Verify, mark hire as "conditional employee" in docs. Have candidate sign acknowledgement about limited access and compliance with remote verification steps.
Global HR Bot: Background check vendor status: pending verification because candidate is overseas. Some vendors require face-to-face identity verification.
Diego (Recruiter): Candidate can provide scanned passport + US driver's license, and upload a UK utility bill for address. Vendor still wants in-person ID check.
Sofia (People Ops): Let's do this: instruct candidate to start day-1 with orientation and no payroll until I-9 done. Payroll, can you confirm we can start payroll on next cycle if W-4 completed and I-9 done within 10 days?
Payroll (Ops): Confirmed — we can delay first payroll by one cycle. Please ensure W-4 submitted before payroll cutoff. If W-4 missing, system applies default withholding.
Sofia (People Ops): I'll prepare a "pre-start checklist" for Amina: 1) Sign conditional employment ack 2) Complete W-4 + direct deposit (optional) 3) Upload ID docs 4) Schedule in-person I-9 within 10 days of start. Also note limits on systems.
Diego (Recruiter): I'll send the checklist and get candidate sign-off. She prefers to start earlier and accept limited access.
Legal (Contracting): Add a line about E-Verify requirement and that we will complete it when in-person verification occurs. Candidate must acknowledge potential need to adjust employment status if E-Verify fails.
Sofia (People Ops): One more: equipment — we'll ship laptop to her UK address but mark device as "enforced MDM + local pickup hold". Courier can release on presentation of govt ID and confirmation email. That keeps onboarding flow smooth.
Payroll (Ops): We'll flag payroll to expect a delayed direct deposit. If candidate wants a check, Payroll can arrange local bank check pickup after I-9 cleared.
Sofia (People Ops): Great. Diego please post candidate acceptance here after she signs. I'll create ticket HR-2054 for conditional start and link Legal notes.
Diego (Recruiter): Will do. Amina agreed to conditional start and signed the acknowledgement. She scheduled in-person I-9 for 10 days out. Sending confirmation now. :white_check_mark:
Sofia (People Ops): Awesome. I'll update the calendar invite to reflect limited access and add the pre-day instructions. Closing loop unless vendor requests additional docs.
